result.title: CFANet: Learning Conflict-Free Weather Adapters for All-Weather Image Restoration
result.summary: All-weather image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse weather degradations such as rain, haze, and snow. Most existing all-in-one methods handle different weather types with a unified network or rely on single-label weather modeling. However, real-world adverse weather is often compositional, where multiple known weather primitives may coexist in a single image. To this end, we propose Conflict-Free Adapter Network (CFANet) for open-compositional all-weather image restoration. CFANet first employs a Weather Mixture Router (WMR) to predict non-exclusive composition weights for rain, haze, and snow from shallow features. Guided by these weights, a Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) dynamically composes a common adapter with weather-private adapters inside each Conflict-Free Adapter Block, preserving shared restoration capability while providing weather-specific residual adaptation. Moreover, a lightweight Natural Color Adapter (NCA) performs constrained color calibration to improve color fidelity and visual naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive adverse weather image restoration performance and benefits downstream visual tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/wenchao-tech/CFANet-main

AI.brief_summary: CFANet 面向全天气图像复原：用 Weather Mixture Router 预测雨、雾、雪的非互斥组合权重，并以此动态组合共享与天气私有 adapter，另加轻量颜色校正模块以在复合退化下提升复原与色彩保真。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是纯图像复原任务，缺乏内部推理状态、证据获取或决策停止等环节；其中的混合路由与共享-私有 adapter 组合虽属条件化计算，但面向退化类型而非推理状态，未提供与 LVR 问题的具体借鉴线索，故排除。
